question: The Government launched a 'Scheme for Expansion and Modernisation of Fire Services in the States' in July 2023 under the ________ for strengthening fire services in the States.
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Government launched a 'Scheme for Expansion and Modernisation of Fire Services in the States' in July 2023 under the **National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF)** for strengthening fire services in the States.
 
• The National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF) was established to meet the expenses for emergency response, relief, and rehabilitation in the wake of disasters.
 
• It is managed by the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.
 
• States can access the NDRF for aid in disaster management, ensuring timely and effective response to emergencies.
 
• The fund is crucial for enhancing the disaster preparedness and response capabilities of states, including fire services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The NDRF is constituted under the Disaster Management Act, 2005.
 
• It aims to provide immediate relief to the victims of disasters and is funded through the levy of a cess on certain items.
 
• The fund's utilization is overseen by the National Executive Committee (NEC) under the Chairmanship of the Union Home Secretary.
 
• The NDRF supplements the State Disaster Response Fund (SDRF) which is the primary fund available to State Governments for disaster response and relief.
 
• Effective utilization of the NDRF is essential for mitigating the impact of disasters and ensuring rapid recovery.
